name: Voxel Mesh Generation with Face Culling
aliases: Voxel Chunk Mesh Generation with Adjacency Culling
Voxel Chunk Mesh Generation with Face Culling
definition: A method to generate a static mesh from a voxel chunk by iterating over all voxels and only rendering faces where the adjacent voxel is empty (air), thereby culling internal faces.
summary: Voxel Mesh Generation with Face Culling is a CPU-based method that converts voxel grids into static triangle meshes by emitting geometry only for faces adjacent to empty space, reducing vertex counts by hiding internal surfaces.
